prompt: Build a login page. There should be a field for the email address, a field for the password that hides what is typed, and a prominent button at the end to submit the whole thing when the user presses Enter.
response:
<form>
  <bl-input name="email" type="email" label="Email address" autocomplete="email" required></bl-input>
  <bl-input name="password" type="password" label="Password" autocomplete="current-password" required></bl-input>
  <bl-button type="submit" variant="primary">Log in</bl-button>
</form>
